source.citation: Improvement of the Chicago Harbor. 1870-02-07. govinfo.gov
what_it_does_not_supply: A validated WGS84 positional accuracy; dates of unrecorded construction between survey and 8 October 1871.
what_it_supplies: Wheeler reports actual harbor entrance and lakefront survey in July and August 1869; accompanying tracing W at 400 feet to one inch (1:4800), extending about three-quarters mile north and one-and-one-quarter miles south of entrance.
Report describes accompanying chronological sketches of 1858, 1865 and end of 1869; matching 1869 sketch found separately as NARA86744439.
Proposed outer harbor is indicated by red dotted lines. Proposal is not proof of built works.
If appropriation made in 1870, material delivery and construction proposed to start early in 1871.
